text:
sam: Heads up — CI on master is failing after yesterday's toolchain image roll (gcc 12 -> gcc 13). Failing target: //core:inference

mira: link?

ci-bot: Build failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/12098 (master)
ci-bot: Last 30 lines:
```
In file included from core/inference/engine.cc:12:
core/inference/engine.h:23:10: fatal error: 'absl/container/flat_hash_map.h' file not found
 #include "absl/container/flat_hash_map.h"
          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
compilation terminated.
```

sam: weird — absl should be in the toolchain sysroot. Might be include path stripped by the new image.

oliver: @sam can you bisect the toolchain image tag? Which commit was deployed?

sam: rolled image tag to toolchain:v2026-03-16-9f84a

oliver: try reverting to v2026-03-15 locally? Also run: `bazel build //core:inference --action_env=CC=/usr/bin/gcc-12 --verbose_failures`

jen: also check `bazel query 'deps(//core:inference)' --output=graph | grep absl` to confirm visibility

mira: I ran a quick grep on the failing container — absl headers are present under /usr/local/include/absl but compiler include paths show only /usr/include

devops: that matches — the new image removes /usr/local/include from CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH to reduce weird vendor mixing. I can push a small fix to restore it or we can update the build to use -isystem

sam: can someone rerun the failing job after we patch the build? I'll open a PR with the isystem change.

ci-bot: Job rerun triggered: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/12098/2 :eyes:

jen: if rerun still fails, we should revert the toolchain image in infra and coordinate a proper roll.

oliver: adding a quick bisect checklist: 1) reproduce locally with same container 2) identify missing include paths 3) try -isystem or update Bazel toolchain 4) revert image if needed

mira: thanks — I'll take 1 and 2 now.

sam: thanks all, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/981 (small isystem patch)

ci-bot: Build passed on rerun: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/12098/2 ✅

sam: great, I'll coordinate a follow-up to harden our toolchain image tests

jen: please add a test that builds //core:all inside the new image before rolling next time :+1:
